title: Renovation & Extensions
description: Reimagine Your Space. Whether you're extending, reconfiguring, or refreshing, we'll help your existing home work better and feel better.
seoDescription: Renovation, extension, and refurbishment design for residential, hospitality, and commercial buildings in Nairobi and across Kenya.

process.title: Discovery & Existing Building Review
process.copy: We assess the existing building, understand how it is used, and identify the goals driving the renovation.

process.title: Site & Building Analysis
process.copy: Structure, circulation, light, ventilation, services, and future opportunities are evaluated.

process.title: Renovation Strategy
process.copy: A clear design approach is developed to improve space, function, comfort, and long-term value.

process.title: Design Development
process.copy: Layouts, extensions, interiors, materials, and architectural interventions are refined into a coordinated proposal.

process.title: Documentation & Approvals
process.copy: Detailed drawings and information are prepared for approvals, pricing, and construction.

process.title: Construction Support
process.copy: We remain involved during implementation to support quality and ensure design intent is maintained.

fullDescription: For clients looking to improve, extend, or adapt an existing home, hospitality venue, or commercial building through thoughtful design.
